note: The operator's allowlist for critical ACT-NOW texts (SPEC_CRITICAL_TEXT_ACTION_ALERTS_20261104). Class ids only: no address ever lives in the repo; the Fi lines are read from operator_contact.json. Turning a class off here stops its texts and nothing else. B4 builds its one-tap reauth link from the runtime tailnet base (TRADEAI_CC_LINK_BASE): the hostname is an address and never lives here.

A1_extended_hours_near_stop.title: Extended-hours price at or near a stop that cannot fire until 9:30

A2_stop_not_raised_after_move.title: A big move left the live stop below the stop policy's own recommendation

B1_no_protective_stop_or_wrong_size.title: No live stop, or the stop quantity differs from shares held

B2_stop_cancelled_expired_rejected.title: The broker cancelled, expired or rejected a protective stop

B3_stop_above_market_premarket.title: The stop is already above the market price before the open

B4_schwab_login_expiring.title: The Schwab refresh token needs the operator's manual re-login

B6_options_expiry_or_assignment.title: Short option near expiry in the money, assignment risk, or a long that would auto-exercise

B7_margin_or_cash.title: Margin call, negative cash, or an order beyond buying power

B8_order_rejected_or_partial.title: An operator order was rejected or only partially filled

B9_monitoring_blind.title: Stop sync, positions or price feed stale beyond its SLA while positions are open

B10_concentration_breach.title: A position has grown past its account cap
